SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = 'revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = 'cases' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_cases,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = 'cogs' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_cogs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = 'grossProfit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_gross_profit,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = 'opex' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_opex,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_code = 'headcount' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_headcount
      FROM CUBE_FACT
      WHERE version = 'actuals'
